title: Lesson 2 Quiz: Liquidity Pools and Impermanent Loss

questions.text: How can trading fees earned in a liquidity pool affect impermanent loss?
options: They make impermanent loss permanent and unrecoverable
They have no effect on impermanent loss at all
They can offset or exceed the loss
They guarantee your pool share beats simply holding
questions.explanation: Impermanent loss is temporary and can be offset or exceeded by the trading fees you earn.

questions.text: True or false: providing liquidity is advisable for highly volatile token pairs because they generate the highest trading fees.
questions.explanation: The narration advises avoiding highly volatile pairs as impermanent loss could outweigh fee income.
